records.context: With ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980) no AI is asked: every UniProt GO term and keyword of the screening experiment's genes, and every CORUM complex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) and Reactome pathway (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), is tested in each cluster by a one-sided hypergeometric test against all the screening experiment's genes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the cluster's terms. The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screening experiment's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. The same tables are written, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; the reference files are copied with their checksum and date so a rerun works offline.

records.source: With ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980) no AI is asked: every UniProt GO term and keyword of the screen's genes, and every CORUM complex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) and Reactome pathway (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), is tested in each cluster by a one-sided hypergeometric test against all the screen's genes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the cluster's terms. The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screen's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. The same tables are written, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; the reference files are copied with their checksum and date so a rerun works offline.
records.translation: Mit ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (Item 980) wird keine KI gefragt: Jeder UniProt-GO-Term und jedes Schlüsselwort der Gene des Screens sowie jeder CORUM-Komplex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) und jeder Reactome-Signalweg (``ops_voyager3_reactome``) wird in jedem Cluster mit einem einseitigen hypergeometrischen Test gegen alle Gene des Screens getestet, mit Benjamini-Hochberg-FDR über die Terme des Clusters. Der beste Term mit einer FDR von höchstens ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, mit mindestens 3 Clustergenen und dem doppelten Anteil des Screens, benennt die Rolle; der Anteil der Clustergene, die ihn tragen, ergibt dieselben Konfidenzwörter, und in Clustern mit high und medium sind die Gene ohne ihn die Kandidaten. Es werden dieselben Tabellen geschrieben, dazu ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; die Referenzdateien werden mit ihrer Prüfsumme und ihrem Datum kopiert, sodass ein erneuter Lauf offline funktioniert.
